title: 1987 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: Abby, Bret, Carl, and Dana are seated in a row of four seats numbered \(1\) to \(4.\) Joe looks at them and says: “Bret is next to Carl.” “Abby is between Bret and Carl.” However, each one of Joe’s statements is false. Bret is actually sitting in seat \(3.\) Who is sitting in seat \(2?\)

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: There is not enough information to be sure

solutions.text:
Bret is in seat \(3.\) Since “Bret is next to Carl” is false, Carl is not in seat \(2\) or seat \(4,\) so Carl must be in seat \(1.\)

The seat between Bret (seat \(3\)) and Carl (seat \(1\)) is seat \(2.\) Since “Abby is between Bret and Carl” is false, Abby is not in seat \(2,\) so Abby must be in seat \(4.\)

That leaves Dana in seat \(2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: “Bret is next to Carl” is false, so Carl is not in seat \(2\) or seat \(4;\) the only remaining seat for Carl is seat \(1\)
Once Carl is in seat \(1,\) “Abby is between Bret and Carl” is false, so Abby cannot be in seat \(2;\) place Abby in the last open seat and see who is left
